main_text.p: substantiæ singularis: aliâs in divinis statuendæ sorent tres substantiæ singulares, cùm tamen tres personæ hîc significent tres modos subsistendi unius ejusdemq; substantiæ singularis, scilicet essentiæ divinæ. Ubi ergò tres sunt personæ, ibi vel tres sunt substantiæ singulares, ut in rebus creatis Petrus, Paulus & Johannes: vel tres sunt modi subsistendi unius ejusdemq; substantiæ singularis, ut in divinis Pater, Filius & Spiritus Sanctus.

21. Persona est vel Increata vel Creata, Persona increata sunt tres: Pater, Filius & Spiritus Sanctus. Persona autem creata est vel Angelica vel Humana. Duplex autem est personam definiendi modus, vel in abstracto vel in concreto: cùm enim in SS. Trinitate triplex Persona tribuitur Deo, Persona vox in abstracto sumitur, non in concreto, & proindè non significat triplicem substantiam singularem intelligentem, sed unius substantiæ singularis intelligentis, essentiæ scilicet divinæ, triplicem subsistendi modum.

page.notes: Printed text is partly unclear in places (show-through from the reverse page is visible in the left margin and was omitted). Words such as "abstracto" and "Persona" may contain a Cyrillic-looking letter in the scan; transcribed as Latin.
